cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: Recruit Them Twice
cards.instruction: Recruit them to your side, then reveal that the side, goal, or conflict is not what it first appeared to be.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Help me tidy the committee cupboard. You remember the dated folders I taught you to use?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: With these three unpaid invoices. You filed them where I could find them, for once. They'll help us replace the treasurer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I agreed to tidy, not overthrow anyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then I'm asking you again. Check those dates as I taught you. If they convince you, will you sign my request for a new treasurer?

reason: Local reread repair: supply actual departure evidence for route questioning and trim duplicate recruitment or credit explanations. Keep the exact earlier contribution and a directly usable final request.
